text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday according to the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Official results of referendum on new constitution show slight fall in turnout of voters and increase in numbers voting against the changes.
- Lessons for Algerians from Portuguese seminar on that country's experience in privatisation.
- Constitutional council announces official results of referendum, showing 84.60 percent voted 'yes' for changes.
- After the referendum to change the constitution, President Liamine Zeroual may make a fresh offer to political parties to enlarge the government.
- Reasons for the choice for change in the referendum.
- Partnership between Algeria and Europe put in focus by visit to Algeria of European Commission Vice-President Manuel Marin.
